title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Intelligence and Reasoning - Letter Analogy
subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: DGRZ is related to HNVG in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, TIHB is related to XPLI. To which of the given options is FDTW related, following the same logic?
questions.explain:
Observe the positional shift for the pairs based on alphabetical order:
D(4) $\rightarrow$ H(8) [ +4 ]
G(7) $\rightarrow$ N(14) [ +7 ]
R(18) $\rightarrow$ V(22) [ +4 ]
Z(26) $\rightarrow$ G(7) [ +7 (wrap around: $26+7=33$, $33-26=7$) ]

The logic pattern is `+4, +7, +4, +7`.
Applying to FDTW:
F(6) + 4 = J(10)
D(4) + 7 = K(11)
T(20) + 4 = X(24)
W(23) + 7 = D(30 $\rightarrow$ 4)
The resulting word is JKXD.

questions.q: NJOM is related to TPUS in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, PLQO is related to VRWU. To which of the following is RNSQ related, following the same logic?
questions.explain:
Let's find the positional shift for the letters:
$N(14) + 6 = T(20)$
$J(10) + 6 = P(16)$
$O(15) + 6 = U(21)$
$M(13) + 6 = S(19)$
The logic is to add $+6$ to each letter. (Confirming with PLQO $\rightarrow$ VRWU: $P+6=V$, $L+6=R$, $Q+6=W$, $O+6=U$ works!).
Applying the same logic to RNSQ:
$R(18) + 6 = X(24)$
$N(14) + 6 = T(20)$
$S(19) + 6 = Y(25)$
$Q(17) + 6 = W(23)$
The related cluster is XTYW.
